description: This Java class defines a fragment for the setup wizard in the AnySoftKeyboard app, providing UI interactions for navigating to language, theme, and general settings screens, and displaying a demo keyboard view.

classes.name: WizardPageDoneAndMoreSettingsFragment
classes.description: A fragment managing the final setup page with options to navigate to language, theme, and general settings, and displaying a demo keyboard.

methods.name: getPageLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout resource ID for this fragment's UI.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes click listeners for navigation buttons and sets up the demo keyboard view.

methods.name: isStepCompleted
methods.description: Indicates whether this setup step is completed; always returns false to allow repeated configuration.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for navigation buttons, launching appropriate activities or finishing the current activity.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Loads the default keyboard and sets up the demo view, also manages view animations.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up the demo keyboard view when the fragment's view is destroyed.
